figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Effect of emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside on the neurological deficit in the
cerebral ischemia-reperfused rats. Rats were treated with emodin-8-O-β-D-
glucoside (2.5, 5, 10 mg/kg, i.v.), vitamin C (20 mg/kg, i.v.) and vehicle after the
cerebral ischemia for 15 min. After the ischemia for 2 h and reperfusion for 24 h,
the neurological deficit of rats was evaluated according to Longa's method. Data
were presented as mean±S. D. (n=13). One-way ANOVA test was used to
determine statistical significance. Asterisks represent significant difference
between the model group and the drug-treated groups (⁎Pb0.05; ⁎⁎Pb0.01).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Effect of emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside on the infarction area of brain in the
cerebral ischemia-reperfused rats. Rats were treated with emodin-8-O-β-D-
glucoside (2.5, 5, 10 mg/kg, i.v.), vitamin C (20 mg/kg, i.v.) and vehicle after the
cerebral ischemia for 15 min. After the ischemia for 2 h and reperfusion for 24 h,
the infarction area was quantified with the method of TTC staining. Data were
presented as mean±S. D.(n=6). One-way ANOVA test was used to determine
statistical significance. Asterisk represents significant difference between the
model group and the drug-treated groups (⁎Pb0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Concentration curve of emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside in the brain tissue and plasma of the normal and cerebral ischemia-reperfused rats. Rats were treated with
emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside (2.5, 5, 10 mg/kg, i.v.) . After 4 h, emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside concentration in the brain tissue and plasma was determined by HPLC. Data
were presented as mean±S.D. (n=6). Fig. 4-A, C represents emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside concentration in the brain tissue and plasma of the ischemia-reperfused rats,
and Fig. 4-B, D represents emodin-8-O-β-D-glucoside concentration in the brain tissue and plasma of the normal rats. One-way ANOVA test was used to determine
statistical significance. Asterisks represent significant difference between the ischemia-reperfused rats and the normal rats in the same time (⁎⁎Pb0.01).
